YOUR OWN JWERO

On your servers, under your policies, paid for once.

Enterprise runs on your premises or in your own cloud. Jwero has no access to your data and charges no recurring fee.

Hosted where you decide

On your own premises or in the cloud account you choose, in the region you choose. Your data never sits with Jwero.

One-time licence

Pay once for the platform. Support and updates are an optional contract, not a condition.

Every module

Counter, stock, CRM, WhatsApp, schemes, gold loans, manufacturing, AI and the rest all run self-hosted. A few, such as WhatsApp and AI calling, need an internet connection to reach their channels.

AI on your terms

Run AI models locally, or connect the models and providers you choose under your own contracts.

Your policies, end to end

Your access rules, backups, audits and retention, with roles per branch and team, SSO, and every action logged and stoppable.

Customised to your requirements

Shape the platform to how your business works: your workflows, fields, rules, screens and integrations. No platform limits deciding what you can and cannot do.

No platform risk

A hosted platform’s downtime, price rises, policy changes and shutdowns stop being your risk. The system keeps running on your infrastructure, on your schedule.

No vendors to coordinate

No ten tools from ten vendors pointing at each other when something breaks. One system, one owner of the fix, and one optional support contract.

FOR YOUR IT EVALUATOR

The technical layer, in one place.

Everything below is live in the product today; verify it against your own checklist.

SSOEnterprise single sign-on with any standard identity provider (Okta, Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace and others), set up by your admin from an in-app settings page with an email-domain allowlist.
ProvisioningJoiners and leavers are handled from your identity provider: accounts are created with a default role and removed when you deactivate someone in your directory.
Roles & permissionsFine-grained permissions bundled into ready-made roles, including a read-only Accountant role for an external CA (reads the books, cannot post entries). Clone and edit any template for a custom role.
Backups & restore verificationEach organisation sets its own backup schedule and retention from an in-app Trust settings screen, which shows the last-backup timestamp. A restore check is part of the product; ask us for the latest result for your workspace.
WebhooksOutbound webhooks with signed payloads, automatic retries and a delivery log, for your own integrations.
Rate limitingMultiple layers of API rate limiting protect the platform from abuse.
AI governanceAutonomy set per kind of action, per-agent guardrails that block destructive actions, approval where you require it, and one switch that stops any agent, branch, channel or everything. See /platform/ai-workforce for the full detail.

MULTI-STORE, MULTI-BRAND, MULTI-BRANCH

Real hierarchy, not a label.

Organisations, brands and branches are a real administrative hierarchy in Jwero, not just a business-type field at signup, role-based access control is scoped independently at each level, so a manager can be scoped to one branch while an owner sees the whole group. What this is not, today: a franchise-specific administration layer with royalty tracking or franchisor oversight of independently-owned franchisees. "Franchise" exists as a business-type label at signup, not a dedicated module, if that's what your evaluation needs, tell us and we'll be straight about the gap.

QUESTIONS EVALUATION COMMITTEES ASK

Answers for your evaluation committee.

Does Jwero work for jewellery chains and groups?

Yes. Branches, brands and roles run on one system with single sign-on and user provisioning, a staged rollout plan and a security overview for your IT team. Enterprise is a one-time licence to run Jwero on your own servers or cloud, and functions can be run by your team, by Jwero, or a mix.

Our evaluation committee will ask about SSO and audit trails. What do we tell them?

Enterprise single sign-on with your identity provider is shipped and live; activity is logged per module. See the full honest list.

How do we roll out across many branches without chaos?

One pilot branch first, with exit criteria you define, then a staged rollout. No branch goes live without the previous one proving itself.

Can we get a security overview document?

Yes, download it directly above, alongside the buying-committee kit.

What about backups and webhooks?

Backups are configured by each business, and a restore check is part of the product; ask us for the latest result. Webhooks work today via the API, with a narrow event catalogue and no admin UI yet, full detail in the table above.

Can we host Jwero on our own servers?

Yes. Enterprise runs on your premises or in your own cloud, with a one-time licence and no recurring fee to Jwero. Jwero has no access to your data.

Do all modules work self-hosted?

Yes, every module. A few, such as WhatsApp messaging and AI calling, need an internet connection to reach their channels.

How does AI work on a self-hosted install?

Run models locally on your infrastructure, or connect the AI models and providers you choose under your own contracts.

What do we pay after the licence?

Nothing recurring to Jwero. Support is an optional contract. You pay for your own hosting and for services you connect, such as WhatsApp messaging and telephony.

What’s different about the enterprise track?

A named specialist instead of a self-serve funnel, a buying-committee kit addressed to each stakeholder, and a staged pilot-branch rollout with exit criteria you set.

What do you need from us to start?

Roughly: number of branches, current systems (billing/ERP/WhatsApp tools), and your evaluation timeline. We’ll come back with a specific plan, not a generic deck.

How do we roll out across many branches without a chaotic big-bang migration?

You don’t, one pilot branch first, with exit criteria you define, then a staged rollout with per-branch configuration and training. No branch goes live without the previous one proving itself.

Can we get a security overview document for our IT committee?

Yes, both the security overview and the full buying-committee kit are downloadable directly on this page, no request needed.

What if different branches want different price rules or catalogues?

Central price rules under owner control, with per-branch exceptions that route through approvals, consistency where you want it, flexibility where you grant it.

How does single sign-on get set up?

An org admin creates the connection from an in-app settings page, allowlists your email domain, and connects your identity provider (Okta, Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace and others). New staff get an account with a default role the first time they sign in, and deactivating someone in your directory removes their Jwero access.

How are backups handled, and how do we know they actually work?

You set your own backup schedule and retention from an in-app Trust settings screen, which shows the last-backup timestamp. A restore check is part of the product; ask us for the latest result for your workspace.

Can we get webhooks into our own systems?

Yes, today, via the API: signed payloads, automatic retries, and a delivery log, so your own systems hear about changes as they happen.
